selected.rationale: The Wellness Optimizer matches the advertiser's value of science-backed products and aligns with the mid-high income wellness audience on Daily Form.
The Convenience-First Millennial matches the impulse-friendly, rapid-fulfillment nature of Swiftcart and aligns with the snack category.
The Fitness Enthusiast seeks performance and functional snacks, fitting the healthy superfood positioning and overlapping with the health-curious beverage audience.

rejected.reason: The Busy Parent prioritizes family-oriented bulk purchases and subscriptions, whereas this advertiser features a one-off business model and a mid-tier $25 AOV.
The Gen Z Aesthete focuses heavily on beauty, fashion, and social-first visual identity rather than functional grocery superfoods.
The Pet Parent focuses strictly on animal food and supplies, which does not align with a human-grade grocery superfood brand.
The Affluent Classic is older and shops primarily for classic apparel, home goods, and travel with a much higher AOV than the brand's $25 target.
The Sustainability Buyer demands deep supply chain transparency and specific eco-certifications, whereas the brief focuses on science-backed convenience rather than explicit eco claims.
The Value-Conscious Shopper is discount-focused and comparison-driven, which clashes with the mid-tier specialty positioning of a healthy superfood snack.
The Gifter looks specifically for premium presentation and gift sets, whereas this product is an everyday grocery snack rather than a gifting item.
